$comment: Shared scoring goldens: executed by crates/core/src/review.goldens.test.rs and packages/run-stats/src/scoring.goldens.test.ts, which both reject unknown keys. Expectations are the Rust core's output. gated_rating / gated_score / gated_overall_grade and their gated* mirrors: each case applies all three to input.gated and the matching input.reviewed figure.

cases.name: a passing typecheck changes nothing
cases.why: The ungated gate is a pass-through for every figure.

cases.name: a failing typecheck forces broken and zeroes the score
cases.why: The score keeps its denominator and review count, reading 0 / total.

cases.name: a gated run nobody reviewed is broken but unscored
cases.why: There is no denominator to report a zero against.

cases.name: an ungated run nobody reviewed stays unrated
cases.why: Nothing invents a figure the reviews did not produce.

cases.name: a gated score with a fractional mean still reads zero
